units.en: If an overlord ⟦0⟧ for some of one of their subject's resources, the subject gains 0.005⟦1⟧ autonomy per day per resource exported. Note that it does not matter how much of those resources the overlord ends up actively using, only how much they receive from ⟦2⟧ with their puppet.
Subjects gain autonomy for their contributions to their overlord's wars roughly equivalent to 60%⟦0⟧ of the war score they generate.⟦1⟧

The continuous focus ⟦0⟧ lowers all subjects' autonomy by 0.5 daily, while the focus ⟦1⟧ raises it by 0.5 daily for the subject taking the focus. If both focuses are active at the same time, they will cancel each other out.
Several nation-specific focuses and ⟦0⟧ increase or decrease autonomy - currently, these are limited to the ⟦1⟧, Commonwealth nations, the ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, and ⟦4⟧.

If an overlord capitulates (to anyone), all of their subjects immediately gain autonomy equal to 50%⟦0⟧ of the total amount of autonomy that would be required for them to progress to their next tier. This is normally 500 autonomy. For fascist overlords who have fewer puppet tiers with much larger autonomy ranges, if they capitulate, their subjects can gain a lot more autonomy.
For ⟦0⟧ overlords who have fewer puppet tiers with much larger autonomy ranges, if they capitulate, their subjects can gain a lot more autonomy.
An overlord sending an ⟦0⟧ to their puppet reduces autonomy by 0.05 per day,⟦1⟧ whereas a puppet sending an attaché to their overlord generates 0.05 autonomy points per day.⟦2⟧

It is possible for puppets to break free from their puppet masters. However, this cannot be done peacefully if the player wishes to do it swiftly. One potential method for achieving this would be to provide increased support for a different ideology than that espoused by the current government, utilizing political advisors and triggering a civil war as a means of liberating oneself from the existing authority structure.

Once hostilities commence, the newly independent government will be engaged in armed conflict with the original puppet government, which may still seek assistance from the puppet master. The outcome of this struggle for independence is contingent upon the rebels' ability to overpower both the master and the loyalists. Should the puppet succeed, they will be presented with the opportunity to assume control of their former overlord.

An alternative method of achieving independence is to increase autonomy to a sufficient degree. One may accomplish this by providing the puppet master with any type of equipment through the Lend-Lease program. In response, the puppet master may attempt to diminish the autonomy of the nation in question by initiating construction projects within its borders or, if consent is granted, by providing loans or other forms of financial assistance. It can be concluded that the attainment of independence through a peaceful process is feasible with the implementation of the Together For Victory strategy; however, it is a protracted and intricate procedure.
Most puppets have the same names as their independent counterparts, however some countries use special names when they are specific kinds of subjects to specific countries:
